plans.text: Increase social media presence, especially on Instagram, and maintain momentum.

Post a poll on an Instagram Story asking followers what they would like more of in the content, with three options: "More writing tips and advice," "More behind-the-scenes content," and "More sneak peeks of the manuscript," and invite them to share thoughts and opinions in the comments.

Create a follow-up Instagram Story featuring a graphic or screenshot of the poll results, context or insights about what was learned, a thank-you to followers for participating and providing feedback, and a highlight of the winning option.
Try using the Question Sticker feature in Instagram Stories for a Q&A session first because it seems like a quick and easy way to get started.
Promote the Q&A session by announcing it in advance, creating a branded hashtag, and specifying the topic or theme as the user's writing process and experiences as a freelancer.
Answer a selection of questions and address common themes during the Q&A, provide additional resources for questions that cannot be answered, and communicate with followers to set expectations.

Post a quick Instagram Story reminder about the Q&A session tomorrow, inviting followers to ask anything about the user's writing process, freelancing, or other topics using the Question Sticker, using the hashtags #QandAwith[YourName], #WritingCommunity, and #FreelanceLife.

superseded_plans.text: Start sharing snippets of the manuscript through Instagram Stories.
Post snippets of the manuscript as new sections are completed, maintain a consistent posting frequency, and ask followers about their content preferences, potentially using Instagram Polls.
Try out a Q&A session idea on Instagram, using either the Question Sticker in Stories or a post asking followers to submit questions in the comments.

preferences.text: Prefers engaging promotional content designed to resonate with the audience and generate more likes and comments.
Likes the idea of using Instagram Stories to share the writing process.
